# Southeast Evanston Association

> > A neighborhood advocacy organization dedicated to protecting quality of life in southeast Evanston through lakefront stewardship, development oversight, and community engagement.

The Southeast Evanston Association (SEA) represents residents of Evanston's First and Third wards, focusing on lakefront protection, zoning and development review, historic preservation, and affordable housing advocacy. The organization actively engages with Evanston City Council, the Land Use Commission, and local institutions like Northwestern University and District 65/202 schools.

## Key Topics

- Lakefront stewardship
- Zoning and development
- Historic preservation
- Community advocacy
- Evanston City Council
- Comprehensive planning
- Affordable housing
- Environmental protection
- Neighborhood association
- Land Use Commission
- 605 Davis Street
- Envision Evanston 2045
- District 65 schools
- Northwestern University
- Urban planning

## Core Advocacy Areas

- [Southeast Evanston Association](https://www.southeastevanston.org): Homepage for SEA neighborhood organization protecting quality of life in southeast Evanston
- [Focus Issues](https://www.southeastevanston.org/focus-issues): SEA's primary focus areas including lakefront stewardship and development zoning
- [Lakefront Stewardship](https://www.southeastevanston.org/lakefront): SEA's lakefront stewardship efforts including Light House Beach and Arrington Lagoon
- [Development & Zoning](https://www.southeastevanston.org/development): SEA's development and zoning advocacy including 605 Davis Street opposition
- [Historic Preservation](https://www.southeastevanston.org/evanston-community): SEA's historic preservation efforts and zoning opposition for Evanston

## Community Engagement

- [Evanston Community](https://www.southeastevanston.org/community): SEA community advocacy on affordable housing, schools, and city council issues
- [Board and Officers](https://www.southeastevanston.org/board-and-officers): SEA board members and leadership including Kennedy, Sullivan, Ash, and Roeder
- [Membership](https://www.southeastevanston.org/membership): SEA membership options, pricing, and subscription levels for supporters

## News & Communications

- [SEA Newsletter](https://www.southeastevanston.org/new-page-1): SEA newsletter covering zoning, historic preservation, and local government issues
- [Local Notes](https://www.southeastevanston.org/local-notes): Local news and community concerns including gambling and video gaming policies

## About SEA

- [History](https://www.southeastevanston.org/history): SEA organization history and civic engagement in First and Third wards
